thread:
Jules Park: Quick sync — Glint accelerated card arrived today. They want a short EAP: NDA signed, basic perf sweep, and a one-pager with early numbers for their marketing team by next Friday. Can we commit?

Ravi Singh: I can own the benchmark run. Need access creds + any runner config from eng-ml.

Maya Chen: NDA from Glint came through yesterday, legal already countersigned and returned. I uploaded it to /partners/glint/NDA_v2.pdf and shared with their legal contact.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks. I’ll spin up a host on the low-latency cluster and pre-install our runtime. What model weight do we plan to test?

Jules Park: Goal is two quick things:
- perf sweep w/ redwood/7b-quant (default quant profile) for latency/throughput
- an end-to-end inference run using the 8k prompt set from the marketplace bench harness

Tom Alvarez: For the perf sweep, use this harness:
```bash
./bench/run_sweep.sh --model redwood-7b-quant --seq 1024 --batch "1,2,4,8" --iters 200 --log /tmp/glint-run.log
```
Expect p50/p95 numbers and token/sec. I’ll parse logs and push summary.

InfraBot: Provisioned cluster: glint-eap-01 (4xA100-40G), docker image redwood/runtime:stable-2024-06, CID: c3f2a9. SSH access: infra@glint-eap-01.redwood.internal

Ravi Singh: Got creds from infra. Running sweep now, ETA ~3 hours. Will attach raw logs to the thread when done.

Maya Chen: Quick reminder — Glint requested we avoid any public numbers until they approve the one-pager. Keep internal channels only, and mark with #partner-confidential.

Lena Ortiz: Noted. I’ll tag artifacts accordingly. Also, Glint asked whether we can try their patched kernel for better PCIe throughput. Is that allowed by infra?

InfraBot: Kernel patching requires a maintenance window. Ops approved a 45-min window tonight at 22:00 PT if you need it. Reply CONFIRM to schedule.

Jules Park: Please confirm by 17:00 PT if you want the patched kernel tonight. Otherwise we’ll run with stock kernel and note it in the one-pager as a potential uplift.

Tom Alvarez: Running results — initial sweep finished. Quick highlights: p50=72ms, p95=240ms at batch=1; token/sec ~ 2100 at batch=8. Raw log: s3://bench-outputs/glint/1718901234/raw.log

Ravi Singh: Added a trimmed log and matrix of results to Google Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/partnerships/glint/eap-results. Will run the full 8k prompt set overnight and post final CSV in the morning.

Glint_Team_Bot: Received raw logs. Glint engineering will ingest tomorrow AM. Please include expected delta if they swap to their kernel.

Maya Chen: Plan for next steps: 1) Ravi completes full run by 08:00 PT tomorrow, 2) Tom produces one-pager draft (internal) for review by end of day tomorrow, 3) schedule 30-min review with Glint next week to approve public text.

Lena Ortiz: Confirmed for the kernel window? I can test small patch in dev before Ops window.

Ravi Singh: CONFIRM kernel window tonight. I’ll coordinate with Tom to snapshot images before patch.

Jules Park: Awesome — thanks team. I’ll keep partner comms on hold per Maya until we have Glint sign-off. Emoji: :white_check_mark:

Tom Alvarez: Action items noted:
- produce p50/p95 table + token/sec CSV (Tom)
- full E2E run on 8k prompt set (Ravi)
- one-pager draft (Jules/Tom)
- schedule partner review (Maya)

Jules Park: If anything blocks, ping me directly.

Ravi Singh: Uploading final CSV now. Link: s3://bench-outputs/glint/1718901234/results.csv

Tom Alvarez: Draft one-pager pushed to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/partnerships/glint/one-pager-draft.md — please review before EOD.

Maya Chen: I’ll book the review slot for next Tue 9am PT and invite Glint engineering + marketing.

Glint_Team_Bot: Acknowledged. Waiting for final artifacts and NDA-marked one-pager for approval.
